rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for sausage as food, including a single item.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zou2 caan1 sik6 hoeng1 coeng2

rows.note: Use this colloquial term when you mean one individual sausage, especially a small one, rather than sausage in general.

example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 coeng2 zai2 hou2 hoeng1

rows.note: Use this slang noun only for the penis sense, not for the food.

example.english: He got kicked in the sausage and can't stand up straight.
example.traditional: 佢畀人踢中賓周，痛到企唔直。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bei2 jan4 tek3 zung3 ban1 zau1 tung3 dou3 kei5 m4 zik6
